paper.title_en: Thermodynamics within and across AdS Gauss--Bonnet holographic CFTs
paper.abstract_en: We study thermal competition within individual holographic conformal field theories (CFTs) and across theories with different anomaly coefficients in five-dimensional AdS Gauss--Bonnet gravity. We derive the work term conjugate to the dimensionless coupling from the boundary first law and use a common boundary clock to compare charged spherical saddles at fixed external source. Varying this source drives a first-order switch between the CFTs at the endpoints of the chosen coupling interval. In the unit-lapse cylinder clock with the zero-type-D vacuum energy, strict concavity at fixed radius reduces the global comparison to these two endpoints. The preferred coupling jumps across the coexistence line, whose slope is related to the entropy difference by a generalized Clapeyron relation. Where the Einstein endpoint itself undergoes small--large coexistence, a third saddle joins the competition and produces a kink in the cross-theory boundary. A compensating change of the external control preserves saddle ordering under finite energy shifts. Within fixed CFTs, we determine the neutral Hawking--Page line and the charged small--large black hole coexistence surface. The critical charge tends to zero at a finite coupling. The entropy gap closes with exponent one half, and the heat capacity diverges with exponent two thirds along a temperature sweep at the critical charge.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在五维AdS Gauss-Bonnet全息框架下研究热力学竞争与黑洞相变，需推导边界第一定律、共存线与广义Clapeyron关系，理论深度和方法结构较充分；主题明确落在黑洞热力学，并涉及Gauss-Bonnet修改引力。
decision.title_zh: AdS Gauss-Bonnet 全息 CFT 内部及跨理论的热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了单个全息共形场论（CFT）内部、以及具有不同反常系数的理论之间在五维 AdS Gauss-Bonnet 引力中的热竞争。我们从边界第一定律推导了与无量纲耦合共轭的功项，并使用共同的边界时钟在固定外部源下比较带电球形鞍点。改变该源会在所选耦合区间的端点处驱动 CFT 之间的一阶切换。在采用零型 D 真空能量、单位失效圆柱时钟的情况下，固定半径处的严格凹性将全局比较约化为这两个端点。偏好耦合越过共存线发生跳变，其斜率通过广义 Clapeyron 关系与熵差相联系。在 Einstein 端点自身经历小-大共存之处，第三个鞍点加入竞争，并在跨理论边界上产生一个拐点。外部控制的补偿性变化在有限能量移动下保持鞍点排序。在固定 CFT 内部，我们确定了中性 Hawking-Page 线以及带电小-大黑洞共存面。临界电荷在有限耦合处趋于零。熵隙以指数二分之一闭合，而热容在临界电荷处沿温度扫描以指数三分之二发散。
